For the first edition of Paradise Sessions, Miss Dreamz joins forces with Kreuzwerk to transform their beloved green-house like wintergarten into a lush daytime oasis of music, community and collective escapism.

Rooted in the values that have always guided our work, Paradise Sessions is a celebration of queer joy, connection and liberation through music. A space where FLINTA, queer and BIPOC communities can gather, dance, socialise and dream together in the warmth of summer (we'll have outdoor space too!).

Expect a carefully curated line-up spanning house, groove, rhythm and dancefloor euphoria, surrounded by greenery, sunlight and the unmistakable energy that emerges when beautiful people come together with intention.

This first edition marks an exciting new collaboration between Miss Dreamz and Kreuzwerk, opening the door to a series dedicated to daytime pleasure, community building and unforgettable dancefloor moments.

Whether you're arriving with friends, lovers or alone, Paradise Sessions invites you to step away from the everyday and enter a world of collective fantasy, movement and joy.

Come dance beneath the glass roof.
Come lose track of time.
Come join us in paradise.
